## Data Source: scalr_wiz_integration

Retrieves information about a Wiz integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scalr_wiz_integration" "example" {
  id = "int-xxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The identifier of the Wiz integration.
- `name` (String) The name of the Wiz integration.

### Read-Only

- `autofail` (Boolean) Whether the run is blocked when the Wiz scan fails or cannot run.
- `client_id` (String) Wiz service-account client ID.
- `default_policies` (Set of String) Wiz CI/CD policy names passed to `wizcli` (`--policies`), one list item per policy.
- `default_scan_name` (String) Default scan name passed to `wizcli` (`--name`).
- `endpoint_mode` (String) Wiz tenant region: `commercial`, `govcloud`, or `fedramp`.
- `environments` (Set of String) List of environments this integration is linked to, or `["*"]` if shared with all environments.
- `status` (String) Status of the integration.
